voiceLine: One repository. Several coding agents. The hard part is no longer generating code. It is controlling the work.
Pytxo keeps Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and OpenCode where they belong. Each vendor owns its own session.
Open your project, or create the guided example with no API key. Describe the outcome, then inspect the plan before anything runs.
Race Shield maps path claims and dependencies into execution waves, so overlapping edits cannot run in the same stage.
Blast Shield gives every agent an isolated workspace. The primary checkout stays unchanged until a human approves the result.
Operations compresses terminal noise into state: running work, agents, path locks, approvals, isolation, cost, and the exact run needing attention.
High-risk actions arrive with requester, workspace, consequence, and run evidence. Approve and apply, or deny and discard.
In this reproducible local harness, Signal reduced structural bytes by eighty-two point eight percent across one hundred eighty-five files, and five of five isolated agents passed.
Keep your tools. Keep control. Turn one engineering mission into one safe, reviewable result. That is Pytxo.
